present: [1.] śóbhate etc. V.+ śóbhe (3s.) śóbhe etc. E.+ śúmbhase etc. śúmbhati etc. -- [6.] śumbháti etc. śumbhámāna

aorist: [1.] aśobhi śúmbhāna śubhāná -- [2.] aśubhat -- [3.] áśūśubhan áśūśubhanta -- [5.] aśobhiṣṭa aśumbhīt 
future: [1.] śobhiṣyati śumbhiṣyati -- [2.] śobhitā śumbhitā

secondary: intensive: śośubhyate -- desiderative: śuśobhiṣate śuśubhiṣa- -- causative: śobhayati etc. AV.+ śubháyati śubháyate etc. 
derivatives: śúbh śubha E.+ śobha C. śobhā B.+ -śobhin E.+ śumbha E.+ -śumbhaka E. śóbhana V.+ śobhaná B.+ śúmbana AV.+ śumbhū́ B. śobhátha SV. śubhrá V.+ śubhrí RV. śúbhvan RV. śóbhiṣṭha RV. śobhayitṛ C. 
This root is, with considerable plausibility, divided by BR. into two: √1śubh, 'glide along', and √2śubh 'beautify'; the former only in V.B.
